_comment: Known-model alias table for launcher scripts (e.g. nemo.sh). Not read by llama-server itself -- llama.cpp's own --models-preset/router mechanism is INI-only (see docs/preset.md). 'filename' is resolved by walking search_paths in order and taking the first match, so no machine-specific absolute path needs to live here. 'chat_template_file' (if set) is relative to this repo's root. 'port' is nemo.sh's default listen port for this model (overridable via NEMO_PORT) -- each entry gets its own so multiple models can run as parallel systemd --user services without colliding.
